name: Khalid Al-Rashid
title: Chief Technology Officer
summary: Chief Technology Officer with 21 years of progressive experience driving digital transformation across energy, petrochemical, and financial services sectors in the GCC. Proven track record delivering SAR 1.2B+ in operational efficiencies, leading technology teams of 350+ professionals, and managing budgets exceeding SAR 500M. Expertise in AI/ML strategy, cloud architecture, cybersecurity, and M&A technology integration. Board member and advisor to leading Saudi technology organizations.

Established AI Center of Excellence and deployed 15 machine learning models, reducing manual processes by 60% and improving demand forecasting accuracy from 72% to 94%
Directed integration of 200+ applications to hybrid cloud architecture (Azure/AWS), reducing infrastructure costs by SAR 45M annually
Led technology due diligence and integration for acquisitions totaling SAR 1.6B, consolidating 5 ERP systems into SAP S/4HANA within 18 months
Built 24/7 Security Operations Center and achieved ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certifications; zero data breaches over 4 years
Scaled technology organization from 120 to 290 professionals across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt, and India; maintained 87% retention rate

Architected real-time data integration platform with Saudi Aramco, enabling automated compliance reporting and reducing administrative overhead by 64%
